acceptance: Public-surface list (verified against runtime lazy exports) recorded in the ADR
Harvest source SHA pinned and recorded
Authored-contract page template agreed, with one worked example page
Drift-check tooling decision recorded (none, or named tool with lazy-export verification result)
Every current reference URL and API anchor mapped (kept or redirect)
description:
Today docs/api.rst and docs/reference/python-api/** (27 .rst files with autodoc directives) render module dumps through autodoc, napoleon and viewcode. Docstrings are being removed (COMMENT-POLICY-001). docs/development/comment-policy.md:5 says a useful public contract belongs in the canonical API reference, so that reference must be authored.

Decide and record in ADR D7:
(1) The deliberately selected public surface: the symbols users are meant to import, derived from benchbox exports, docs and examples. Not every module member. benchbox/__init__.py uses lazy __getattr__ exports, so the list must be verified at runtime, not only by static scan.
(2) The authored format: Markdown pages per area (benchmarks, platforms, results, utilities), each with purpose, parameters, return semantics, examples and compatibility notes.
(3) Harvest: port the existing explanations, parameter descriptions, examples and notes from docstrings at a pinned SHA taken before docstring removal, so content is not lost.
(4) Optional tooling: griffe or similar may extract signatures and types or check drift between the authored contracts and code. It may never render explanatory docstrings, and its handling of lazy exports must be verified before use.
(5) Release pinning: the reference documents the released wheel, per adr-independent-publication-authorities.
(6) A URL map for every existing reference URL and anchor: kept path, or a counted redirect page.
Rejected: keeping a reduced Sphinx autodoc lane.
